label: supplemental-http-behavior
argv:
import json,runpy,sys
from uuid import UUID
m=runpy.run_path(sys.argv[1]); guard,denied=m["install_guards"]()
import httpx
from huron.client import Client
from huron.catalog import Dataset,DatasetNotFoundError,InvalidResponseError
identity=UUID(int=1); cases=[]
class Body(httpx.SyncByteStream):
    def __init__(self,data,broken=False): self.data=data; self.broken=broken; self.closed=False
    def __iter__(self):
        yield self.data
        if self.broken: raise httpx.ReadError("fixture partial stream")
    def close(self): self.closed=True
class Transport(httpx.MockTransport):
    def __init__(self,handler): super().__init__(handler); self.closed=0
    def close(self): self.closed+=1
for status in (301,307,401,403,409,429,503):
    requests=[]; body=Body(b"{}"); transport=Transport(lambda request: (requests.append(request),httpx.Response(status,stream=body,headers={"location":"https://unexpected.invalid/"}))[1]); client=Client(transport=transport)
    try:
        with client: client.datasets.get(identity)
    except httpx.HTTPStatusError as error: assert error.response.status_code==status
    else: raise AssertionError(status)
    assert len(requests)==1 and body.closed and client.is_closed and transport.closed==1
    cases.append("status-"+str(status))
body=Body(b"{",broken=True); transport=Transport(lambda request: httpx.Response(200,stream=body)); client=Client(transport=transport)
try:
    with client: client.datasets.get(identity)
except httpx.ReadError: pass
else: raise AssertionError("read error suppressed")
assert body.closed and client.is_closed and transport.closed==1; cases.append("midbody-read-error-cleanup")
requests=[]; response_values=[(404,{}),(200,{"id":str(identity),"title":"fixture recovery"})]
def exchange(request):
    requests.append(request); status,value=response_values.pop(0); return httpx.Response(status,json=value)
transport=Transport(exchange)
with Client(transport=transport) as client:
    try: client.datasets.get(identity)
    except DatasetNotFoundError: pass
    else: raise AssertionError("404 suppressed")
    assert not client.is_closed
    assert client.datasets.get(identity)==Dataset(identity,"fixture recovery")
assert client.is_closed and transport.closed==1 and len(requests)==2; cases.append("same-client-error-then-success")
assert guard.attempts==[] and denied==[]
print(json.dumps({"cases":cases,"case_count":len(cases),"forbidden_import_attempts":guard.attempts,"external_io_attempts":denied}))
